_readme: Base44 entity (database) schemas for the SAT Command Center. In Base44, open the Data/Entities panel, create each entity below, and paste its JSON schema. Base44 automatically adds: id, created_date, updated_date, created_by (the user's email). Do NOT re-add those.

Question.name: Question
Question.description: The SAT question bank. One record per question. Import base44/questions.json into this entity to seed it.

question_id.description: Stable unique key, e.g. m01, r03

answer_index.description: Index of correct choice for MC (0=A)

answer_text.description: Correct value for grid-in (accepts numeric equivalents)

is_premium.description: If true, only premium users can be served this item

Attempt.name: Attempt
Attempt.description: One record every time a user answers a question (practice OR test). Drives stats, mastery, streaks, and the review list.

session_id.description: Groups attempts from one practice set or test

TestSession.name: TestSession
TestSession.description: One record per completed full-test simulation. Powers the score report and Progress history.

rw_hard.description: Routed to the higher R&W Module 2

math_hard.description: Routed to the higher Math Module 2

Bookmark.name: Bookmark
Bookmark.description: A user's saved/starred questions for later review. One record per (user, question).

_UserEntity.note: Base44 has a BUILT-IN User entity (do not recreate it). Add these CUSTOM fields to it via the User entity settings so each signed-in user carries their own study state and plan.

plan.description: Set to 'premium' by the Stripe webhook on active subscription

subscription_status.description: e.g. active, canceled, past_due — mirrored from Stripe

daily_quota_date.description: Date the free quota counter applies to
